[[Sinjoh Ruins]] }} '''All About Arceus VI''' (Japanese: '''VS アルセウスVI''' ''VS Arceus VI''), titled '''VS Arceus VI''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 457th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 16th chapter of the {{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}. It is subtitled '''Return from the Crack of Time!''' (Japanese: '''「はざま」からの帰還！''' ''Return from the Crack!'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Return from the Crack in Time''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} At the [[Ilex Forest]], [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken, Al, and Harry]] are on patrol—ordered by {{adv|Giovanni}} to prevent anyone suspicious from entering. As the three stop to celebrate Giovanni's return, they are interrupted by the arrival of [[Pibu|a mysterious, smiling figure]]. Meanwhile, at the [[Sinjoh Ruins]], {{adv|Gold}}, {{adv|Silver}}, and {{adv|Crystal}} watch in shock as [[Pryce]], [[Lance]], and Giovanni enter. Seeing his friends' confusion, Silver confirms to them that Giovanni, the leader of [[Team Rocket]], is his father. While Gold is surprised by this information, he is still astounded by Pryce's appearance. Despite the three villains' attempts to take over the world in the past, as well as their mutual dislike of each other, they explain that they are banding together to prevent the {{adv|Pokémon of myth}} from fighting. Pryce scolds [[Archer]] for not understanding the ancient rivalry between the Legendary Pokémon. When Archer is angered, Pryce explains that he has seen this battle play out in a "crack of time." He commands his {{p|Swinub}} to distract the Pokémon from beginning to battle. {{p|Dialga}} uses {{m|Roar of Time}}, but it has no effect on Pryce due to him having once tried to control time. Taking on {{p|Palkia}}, Lance tells his {{TP|Lance|Dragonite}} to use {{m|Hyper Beam}}. Even though Palkia uses {{m|Spacial Rend}} to send the move outside, Dragonite is able to redirect the Hyper Beam back inside and hit Palkia. Giovanni sends {{TP|Silver|Ursaring}} to fight {{p|Giratina}}, and Archer begs him to refrain from stopping the Legendary Pokémon. Giovanni shoves his hat onto Archer's face to silence him and tells his {{tc|Executive}}s that he will deal with them later. Gold, Silver, and Crystal watch in awe as it seems Dialga, Palkia, and Giratina will be defeated, but Pryce explains that it cannot happen. He tells the three that he and the others can only force the Pokémon to return to where they belong, which is necessary to prevent them from fighting. He tells Gold and Crystal to look at their [[Pokégear]]s, and the two are shocked to see they are outside of the [[Johto]] region. Pryce explains that the Sinjoh Ruins are a very unstable place that exists in another [[dimension]]. It connects Johto and [[Sinnoh]], and a battle between three Legendary Pokémon in such a place could result in the destruction of both regions. Pryce says that he witnessed this destruction from the crack of time, and was permitted by {{adv|Celebi}} to prevent it from happening. ==Major events== * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken, Al, and Harry]] are revealed to be guarding the [[Ilex Forest]] for {{adv|Giovanni}}. * Giovanni, [[Pryce]], and [[Lance]] battle {{p|Giratina}}, {{p|Dialga}}, and {{p|Palkia}}, respectively. * The [[Sinjoh Ruins]] are revealed to exist in an alternate dimension that links the [[Johto]] and [[Sinnoh]] regions. * Pryce reveals that it was {{adv|Celebi}} who brought him back. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Silver}} * {{adv|Crystal}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} * [[Pryce]] * [[Lance]] * [[Archer]] * [[Ariana]] * [[Petrel]] * [[Proton]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Ursaring}} ({{OP|Silver|Ursaring}}; with {{adv|Giovanni}}) * {{p|Swinub}} ([[Pryce]]'s) * {{p|Dragonite}} ({{OP|Lance|Dragonite}}) * {{p|Mime Jr.}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]]'s) * {{p|Hypno}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]]'s) * {{p|Skorupi}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]]'s) * {{p|Dialga}} ({{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga|Adventures}}) * {{p|Palkia}} ({{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia|Adventures}}) * {{p|Giratina}} ({{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Giratina|Adventures}}; {{form|Giratina|Origin Forme}}) ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=EBEBEB|bordercolor=CEB654 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 阿爾宙斯 VI|VS Arceus VI}} |fr=Par-delà les failles du temps |de=VS.
